regions.merged_text: Marcia Anna Fabian - Months old, "hopeless" - brain tumor in Reilly Hospita .- Indianapolis - enrolled in S.M.Ass'n - Mother not Catholic but believes in Jesus, comes in afterwards . June 3rd parents return; no improvement in baby's condition - possibly worse." Parents enroll - selves. They are urgent to "promise" - he to get back to holy sacraments, etc, - she to study up about religion, etc. if Baby is spared etc. - enrolling selves for a year.

regions.merged_text: Notable Case. 1949 -Bobby Sweeney 6 of - Christ the King Parish Detroit reported yesterday "threatening condition ... Para Lukemia" . . . Friends had promised their car if little B. were well enough to make the trip .... First Holy Communion in bed last Sunday .... fever all week 103 to 106 till phone call yesterday - "Emergency Enrollment" Received this a.m. Ist time in Church is here this p.m. - bright and smiling .... alert.

regions.merged_text: From Elmira, New York - Nov. $1.00 Amedes 54-55 -enrolled in Sept. last .. . Hopeless cancer of esophagus ... . In one week, swallowing normal ... gained 5 1bs. Instead of sending him home - cured - Dr's gave him deep therop ... treatments and at once cancer mani- fested itself .... now spread worse than ever. Enrolled again To-day when Dr's have absolutely no hope of helping, giving patient at most 2 weeks to live. Sister-in-law enrolls Poor Souls for same intention.
